note: Layer B of the round quality (product/17_LEVEL_GENERATION_RULES.md §13, product/plans/round-generation-flow-proposal-2026-10-27.md): metrics of interest with bounds calibrated on the owner's ratings. mode 'soft': a placement preference and a note in the audit; 'hard': the audit fails the level. A bound moves to 'hard' once two owner samples confirm it. Change the numbers here, not in the scripts.

pressure.what: pods without work: mean number of placed pods whose colour has no reachable cell, over random games (a launch as soon as one is possible), time-weighted (measure.mjs pressure)
pressure.calibration: pilot v12: introductions rated boring 0.07-0.17, L1-3 0.13-0.24, Hard L10 rated easy 0.96, levels rated interesting 0.67-2.66 (Hard and Super Hard 2.09-2.66)

sample.what: the owner's sample of a wave (rounds.mjs run builds a pilot with it)

mismatch.what: an owner rating that disagrees with the metrics (rounds.mjs review)
